## Acceptance criteria
Gating (§2.9.2), deterministic:
- **AC-A2-1** — §2 two-level statement, seven planes w/ core questions, two boundaries, three cross-cutting attributes, a `home` for every entity kind/class/event family; totality of `classify_home`; `UnclassifiedKind`.
- **AC-A2-2** — the formal model of §2.5 present; every symbol (κ, B, β, Δ, Ψ, θ, M, J, E, D, π_M, π_system) resolves to §2.
- **AC-A2-3 (T-LCD-13) static half** — the taxonomy contains the three chain events with `detector` provenance; the per-profile compliance metric *form* is present (computation is Stage 3).
- **AC-A2-4 (T-LCD-15) static half** — every metric carries `applies_to_classes`/`requires_observability`; a one-native-one-hosted fixture renders `n/a` on inadmissible cells.
- **AC-A2-5 (T-LCD-09) static half** — a configuration record has all six factors explicit and β is representable as a factor; "does variant V help M₁ more than M₂?" expressible against the data model.
- **AC-A2-6 (T-LCD-06/-07) static half** — `admissible_granularities` never coerces `unknown`; the spec-DAG check reports `tier_violations=[]`, `cycles=[]`, no HIR→Hosting-ABI edge while `proj_ABI` is total on native ledgers.
- **AC-A2-7** — glossary check passes with the v4 register: no unregistered synonym, no "meta-" sub-concept, "HarnessHarness" only the proper noun.

Universal phase-gate AC: verification green; every new behaviour has a test that fails if removed; requirement ids stamped in the PR; anything not automatically verifiable is a DEFERRALS row + compensating control; ADRs for every deviation/owned decision; BUILD_INDEX row + LEDGER advanced.

Cross-cutting invariants re-checked by gap-analysis: CC1–CC10 (esp. **CC10 home-plane/ownership originates here**; CC1 one scheme per concern; CC4 language-neutral contracts — the crate is the E1 build binding only; CC7 single schema source; CC8 additive).

## Plan
New persistent crate `crates/hh-ontology` — the C0/Stage-1 formal model as a typed, deterministic, pure-std Rust binding of §2 (CC4: the crate is the E1 realization; the contracts name no language). Modules:
- `planes` — seven `Plane`s w/ core questions; `Boundary` (model/environment); `Home = Plane | Boundary | RunLifecycle`; the registered-kind set (IR entity kinds, component classes, plane operators, event families); `classify_home(kind) -> Result<Home, UnclassifiedKind>` **total** over registered kinds; adding a plane = ADR + re-run totality (documented). CC10 originates here.
- `formal` — the symbol registry (θ, M, E, D, B, κ, β, Δ, Ψ, J, π_M, π_system); `resolve(symbol) -> SymbolDef{name, definition, section}` total (AC-A2-2). Δ = harness effect, 𝒟 = decision-point set (CF-474).
- `config` — `Configuration` κ = (M-set, h, p, E, B, seed); `configuration_id` (semantic, seed excluded — results aggregate) and `configuration_version_id` (exact-bytes manifest key, seed included — rows keyed); six factors explicit; β representable as a factor (AC-A2-5).
- `participant` — `ParticipantClass{native, hosted}`; `ParticipantDescriptor`; `admissible_granularities(descriptor)` derived, never declared; `ClassUndeclared`, `InadmissibleFactor`; `ledger ∈ observability_level ⇔ native` entailed; `unknown` never coerced (AC-A2-4/-6).
- `compliance` — `validity(artefact, at) -> {valid, invalid, unknown}` model-free + identical across configs; the three chain events (`context.artefact.delivered`/`activated`, `verification.artefact.followed`) with `detector ∈ {deterministic, judged, human}`; `MetricDeclaration{applies_to_classes, requires_observability, detector_classes_allowed, …}`; `NaReason` typed value never 0 (AC-A2-3/-4).
- `surface` — `FittedSurfaceReport` shape (derived view, never truth) + `fit_surface` returning `UnknownLevel` on an unprobed categorical level (no interpolation; static half).
- `control` — closed `DecisionPoint` sum; `ControlBoundary{assignments, guards}`; β : 𝒟 → {code, model, human}; envelope-reserved points always `code`; `IncompatibleBoundary`.
- `dag` — `spec_dag_check() -> DagReport{tier_violations, cycles, hosting_edges}` over the §2 constructs; asserts `[] / [] / []` and `proj_ABI` totality (AC-A2-6).
- `glossary` — the v4 register; `glossary_check(text)` fails on unregistered synonym, a "meta-" sub-concept, or "HarnessHarness" not as the proper noun (AC-A2-7).
No new external deps (hermetic). Not a dependency the kernel *requires* yet, but a persistent workspace member (unlike the throwaway `hh-baseline`). CC7: the ontology tables are defined once here (single source); no surface binding consumes them yet at Stage 1, so no codegen edge is added (recorded as an owned decision ADR).

here) with a total `classify_home`; the two boundaries; the two ontology levels and three
cross-cutting attributes; the formal-model symbol registry (θ,M,E,D,B,κ,β,Δ,Ψ,J,π_M,π_system);
configuration κ with both configuration ids; the two participant classes + `admissible_granularities`;
validity-vs-compliance with the three chain events; the compatibility-surface shape; the control
boundary β; the glossary register + check; and the spec-DAG check. Registered as a workspace member
(not throwaway), pure-std, offline, hermetic; covered by the existing CI (`cargo test --workspace`).
